name: Kindal Moonweaver
summary: From a hidden perch in Feralas, Kindal Moonweaver watches the Grimtotem Compound and its captured beasts. Troubled by their mistreatment, she seeks help to free them and protect young animals. She is kin to Jer'kai Moonweaver, and both defend the forest's creatures.

sections.title: A Watcher in the Clifftops
sections.body:
East of Dire Maul, Kindal Moonweaver watches the valley from a hidden perch along a narrow, winding mountain path. The path lies behind timber, north of the Grimtotem Compound. Feralas is contested by the Horde, the night elves of Feathermoon, and the ancient ruins of Eldre'Thalas.

Kindal's concern is the nearby hollow, where the Grimtotem tribe keeps a fortified compound. They capture and pen local wildlife for cruel ends. From her concealed overlook, Kindal watches for anyone willing to brave the enemy camp and free the beasts.

sections.title: Compassion for the Wild
sections.body:
Kindal seeks to preserve Feralas's sacred balance and protect its gentle creatures from their brutish captors. With her kin, Jer'kai Moonweaver, she works to free caged beasts and find help for young animals left stranded by poaching.

Her concern is close at hand: freeing caged sprites and finding a home for an orphaned sprite darter.

faq.answer: Kindal hides along Feralas's northern cliffs, east of Dire Maul and above the Grimtotem Compound. A narrow, hidden mountain path winds uphill behind timber to her perch.
Kindal Moonweaver is a solitary night elf who protects Feralas's wildlife. She watches the Grimtotem Compound and seeks to stop its capture of local beasts.

faq.q: What is Kindal's goal in Feralas?
faq.answer: Kindal wants to free creatures held in cages at the nearby Grimtotem Compound and find safe shelter for orphaned beasts of the wilderness.

faq.q: Is Kindal Moonweaver related to Jer'kai Moonweaver?
faq.answer: Yes. Kindal is kin to Jer'kai Moonweaver, and both work to rescue mistreated and displaced woodland creatures in Feralas.

faq.q: Why is Kindal opposing the Grimtotem?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem clan in the compound below Kindal's perch captures and cages Feralas's wild beasts. Kindal wants to free the creatures and punish their captors.

faq.q: Does Kindal Moonweaver offer quests to both factions?
faq.answer: No. Kindal makes her requests only to the Alliance, enlisting its adventurers to free the caged creatures from the Grimtotem.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Kindal guarding beasts threatened by outsiders, alone in Feralas's wilds.
As a druid, you may share Kindal's devotion to forest life and her effort to free nature spirits from cruel iron cages.
As a hunter of Kalimdor's beasts, you can respect Kindal's work to protect wild young and punish those who capture game for sport or malice.
